import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem closed_subspace_countable_trace_basis_union {K : Type*} [MetricSpace K] [CompactSpace K] {A : Set K} (hA : IsClosed A) :
  ∃ (B : Set (Set K)), Set.Countable B ∧
    (∀ U ∈ B, IsOpen U) ∧
    TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis
      (Set.image (fun U : Set K => (Subtype.val : A → K) ⁻¹' U) B) ∧
    (∀ V : Set A, IsOpen V →
      V = ⋃₀ {T : Set A |
        T ∈ Set.image (fun U : Set K => (Subtype.val : A → K) ⁻¹' U) B ∧ T ⊆ V}) := by
  classical
  letI : CompactSpace A := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hA.isCompact
  
  obtain ⟨C, hCcount, _hCne, hCbasis⟩ :=
    TopologicalSpace.exists_countable_basis (α := A)
  
  have hRep : ∀ c ∈ C, ∃ U : Set K, IsOpen U ∧
      (Subtype.val : A → K) ⁻¹' U = c := by
    intro c hc
    exact isOpen_induced_iff.mp (hCbasis.isOpen hc)
  
  choose f hfopen hftrace using hRep
  
  let g : Set A → Set K :=
    fun c => if hc : c ∈ C then f c hc else ∅
  
  let B : Set (Set K) := g '' C
  
  have hBcount : B.Countable := hCcount.image g
  
  have hBopen : ∀ U ∈ B, IsOpen U := by
    rintro U ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    simpa [g, dif_pos hc] using hfopen c hc
  
  have htrace :
      Set.image (fun U : Set K => (Subtype.val : A → K) ⁻¹' U) B = C := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · rintro V ⟨U, ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      simpa [g, dif_pos hc, hftrace c hc]
    · intro c hc
      refine ⟨g c, ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      simpa [g, dif_pos hc, hftrace c hc]
  
  have hBasis :
      TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis
        (Set.image (fun U : Set K => (Subtype.val : A → K) ⁻¹' U) B) := by
    rw [htrace]
    exact hCbasis
  
  have hUnion : ∀ V : Set A, IsOpen V →
      V = ⋃₀ {T : Set A |
        T ∈ Set.image (fun U : Set K => (Subtype.val : A → K) ⁻¹' U) B ∧
        T ⊆ V} := by
    intro V hV
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hxc, hsub⟩ :=
        hCbasis.exists_subset_of_mem_open hx hV
      have hcD : c ∈ {T : Set A |
          T ∈ Set.image (fun U : Set K => (Subtype.val : A → K) ⁻¹' U) B ∧
          T ⊆ V} := by
        refine ⟨?_, hsub⟩
        rw [htrace]
        exact hc
      exact Set.mem_sUnion.mpr ⟨c, hcD, hxc⟩
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨T, hTD, hxT⟩ := Set.mem_sUnion.mp hx
      exact hTD.2 hxT
  
  exact ⟨B, hBcount, hBopen, hBasis, hUnion⟩
